hero.title: MBA for an AI World (With Dual Specialisation)
hero.lead: ATLAS ISME’s MBA is not just a degree, it’s your AI-powered launchpad into leadership. A future-ready MBA that combines strong management foundations with the power of AI and analytics.

panes.label: Overview

text.strong: MBA in Business Analytics at ATLAS ISME

text:
is designed for future data leaders, strategy consultants, and digital transformation specialists. Whether you aim to harness big data for decision-making, design predictive models, or lead AI-driven transformations — this program equips you to thrive in a data-first world.

You’ll learn to combine

text.strong: analytics with strategy, technology with business insights, and data with leadership

text: . From data visualization to predictive modeling, AI applications to business intelligence, supply chain analytics to corporate strategy — every subject is taught with industry projects and real-world datasets.

cards.title: Transform data into actionable business insights.
Apply predictive and prescriptive analytics to solve challenges.
Integrate AI and machine learning in business strategies.
Strengthen decision-making with econometric and visualization tools.
Drive innovation through big data ecosystems.

semesters.title: Semester 1
semesters.text: Lays strong foundation in management, people skills, research, and values, blending theory with applied learning to prepare students for analytics-focused coursework.

courses.title: Professional Communication and Presentation Skills- Career and Leadership Development - I
courses.text: Develops impactful communication and presentation techniques, enhancing clarity, confidence, and persuasion skills crucial for professional success, leadership roles, and collaborative workplace environments.
Provides insights into international markets, cultural diversity, economic systems, and global business trends, preparing students to make informed strategic decisions in a dynamic economy.

Learn to interpret financial statements, assess profitability, liquidity, and solvency, and apply analytical tools for strategic decision-making, valuation, and business performance evaluation in diverse industries.

Explore modern marketing strategies, consumer behavior shifts, digital integration, and branding innovations, equipping you to craft impactful campaigns in today’s dynamic, competitive business environment.

Gain foundational knowledge of entrepreneurship and family business dynamics, focusing on opportunity identification, innovation, governance, succession planning, and strategies to build sustainable ventures across generations.

courses.title: Driving Decisions by Excel And Modern Age AI Tools
courses.text: Master Excel from fundamentals to advanced analytics, covering data organisation, visualisation, forecasting, decision modelling, and generative AI tools to automate insights and solve complex business problems.

courses.title: Introduction to Digital Marketing
courses.text: Understand the fundamentals of digital marketing, including SEO, social media, content strategies, and analytics, to design campaigns that drive engagement, brand growth, and conversions.

compare.title: Why our Semester 1 curriculum outpaces every other business school
compare.text: Early foundation in finance, global business, AI tools, leadership, and electives, blending theory with practical applications for future-ready financial expertise.

semesters.title: Semester 2
semesters.text: Introduces Python, machine learning, data visualization, and predictive analytics with business context, equipping students with core technical and analytical problem-solving skills.

title.strong: Managing Self and People Skills with Human Centered Design Thinking- Career and Leadership Development- II

courses.text: Develops emotional intelligence, leadership, and teamwork skills; applies design thinking for user-centric problem solving; and strengthens personal branding and networking to enhance professional presence and career growth
Explores corporate social responsibility, sustainable development goals, and business research methods to integrate ethical practices and informed decisions into corporate strategies.
Covers statistical techniques and applications to analyze data, identify trends, and support evidence-based decision-making in diverse business contexts.
Teaches predictive analytics methods to forecast outcomes, optimize strategies, and minimize risks, enhancing data-driven decision-making in complex business scenarios.
Applies R programming for advanced analytics, including data manipulation, visualization, and modeling, empowering professionals with practical, industry-relevant analytical skills.
Focuses on transforming complex data into compelling stories with visualization, narrative, and context to influence decision-makers and drive actionable business insights.

items.text: Explores responsible AI practices, addressing bias, fairness, transparency, and governance, ensuring technology aligns with ethical standards and sustainable business goals.
Introduces data visualization and reporting using Power BI, enabling effective dashboards, business insights, and decision-making through interactive, real-time analytics tools.

semesters.title: Semester 3
semesters.text: Emphasizes applied analytics in organizational behavior, cybersecurity, economics, and leadership resilience, with advanced predictive modeling, business intelligence, and visualization electives for specialization.

courses.title: Organizational Behaviour & Human Values - Career and Leadership Development - III
courses.text: Learn to make strategic, big-picture decisions by evaluating competition, allocating resources, and planning for long-term success, while developing adaptability, resilience, and effective leadership in dynamic environments.

courses.title: Economics and Cyber Governance
courses.text: Applies economic theories to real-world business challenges, analyzing data, assessing trade-offs, and making strategic decisions, while integrating cybersecurity, risk management, and digital resilience for technology-driven business protection.
Provides hands-on industry experience and research opportunities, enabling practical application of skills, problem-solving, and development of actionable insights for real-world business challenges.
Introduces practical machine learning concepts, algorithms, and applications, empowering managers to leverage AI for business forecasting, optimization, and strategic decision-making.
Develops expertise in querying, managing, and transforming databases using SQL, enabling efficient data extraction, manipulation, and reporting for analytical decision-making.
Applies data analytics to measure, monitor, and optimize sustainability initiatives, helping organizations achieve environmental goals while balancing profitability and social responsibility.
Teaches coding fundamentals and automation tools for managers, enabling data-driven decision-making, process optimisation, and effective integration of technology in business operations.

items.text: Equips students with statistical and machine learning techniques to forecast business trends, optimize decision-making, and mitigate risks using real-world data sets.
Develops skills to present complex datasets visually through Tableau, enabling clear insights, interactive dashboards, and compelling data-driven storytelling for managerial decisions.

Teaches creating interactive dashboards and visualizations to analyze business data, support decision-making, and communicate insights effectively.
Covers analyzing textual and social media data using AI tools to extract insights, track trends, and guide marketing strategy.
Introduces Python fundamentals and applications for managers to automate tasks, analyze data, and support data-driven decision-making.
